seal.statement: Always-loaded steering contains only cross-cutting invariants and routing; everything detailed or owner-specific lives at its authoritative owner and is loaded only when relevant. Every line of the corpus at 60bd588f5 is first classified by responsibility, then moved to its owner, kept as conditional material, or deleted as duplication or retired mechanism. rules.md carries exactly 25 rules derived from the real cross-cutting invariants, each stating an invariant and routing to its owner rather than restating the owner's detail; rules.json is gone; the transitive always-load path is at most 360 lines and the corpus at most 3000; no current steering presents any of the 18 retired v1 verbs as an available operation; and representative tasks are shown to reach their authoritative owner from the always-load layer with no invariant lost. Mechanical ratchets keep all of it from growing back.

text: Inventory before editing, at the frozen baseline 60bd588f5: the authored steering corpus is 6,777 lines in 203 sections, and docs/steering/llm (15,326 lines) is entirely generated from it, of which rules.json alone is 12,462. Classified by responsibility: conditional 2,620; always-load invariant 1,498; historical or retired 1,079; owner routing 980; owner duplication 434; explanation or example 166. Recorded at solve/epics/solve-v2/steering-inventory.json. Two consequences: the diet is mostly an information-architecture move rather than prose compression, since 4,299 of the 6,777 lines are conditional, duplicated, historical or illustrative; and the 3,000-line corpus target is reachable only if conditional material leaves docs/steering for the owner that holds it, because everything under that directory counts.

Relocation and retirement. Moved 3,339 lines of owner detail to the owners that hold it (docs/development, test/guidelines, architecture, test/distributed) and deleted 2,923 lines as duplication, illustration or retired mechanism. Retired the whole v1 pack surface: the generator, its config, the compiled rules.json corpus, rules-index.md, the four domain packs, core.md/boot.md, the npm run rule CLI and the dead llm-steering-usability scenario runner. AGENTS.md now loads exactly rules.md plus router.md. Rewired every consumer: roadmap authority now validates the router's conditional-material section instead of the pack config, the budget's rules and always-load rows delegate to the steering-diet checker instead of re-deriving them, and rules-json-absent became retired-steering-surfaces so the generator cannot come back under another name.

Adversarial verification of the relocation and retirement attempt. Rejected with eleven defects. Severe: the inventory excluded docs/steering/llm on the premise that it is wholly generated, but core.md (273 lines) and boot.md (139) were hand-curated always-load material, so 412 lines of the layer this quest exists to shrink were never classified; three normative invariants died with them or with a wrong duplicate-delete (the authorization stop trigger, the user-facing-model-stays-small rule, the commit-on-completion posture); CLAUDE.md was converted from a symlink into a byte copy, creating a second unmeasured entry document; registered-operation closure is measured over docs/steering only and 31 references to 17 retired operations survive in the relocated corpus. Four of the ten scenarios cannot fail in the way that matters.

Repair of the eleven rejection defects. The inventory is now derived from the frozen baseline by scripts/checks/steering-baseline-inventory.js rather than transcribed, so it covers 262 sections over 60 files including core.md and boot.md, at section granularity, under one line convention that the budget and the diet checker both consume; a test re-derives it and compares. The two lost invariants are back inside their existing owners: R16 now covers taking an irreversible or outward-facing action only where the authority already exists, and the router's conflict section states that a person's instruction and safety limits outrank every document. The user-facing model contract moved to architecture/runtime-contracts.md and the commit and parallelism postures to the solver runbook. CLAUDE.md is a symlink again. Registered-operation closure now scans every instruction tree, which found 31 references to 17 retired operations and drove the runbook rewrite. Four scenarios that could not fail were replaced by five that do, proved by perturbation.

Second adversarial verification of the repaired change. Approved. All eleven defects fixed: the inventory was independently re-derived from the frozen baseline with the verifier's own generated-file set and section splitter and matched exactly at 60 files, 262 sections, 7131 lines with zero per-file mismatches; the relocated invariants were diffed against the baseline text; CLAUDE.md is mode 120000 again; the closure regex over the entire live corpus went from 31 references to 0 after the runbook rewrite and the statechart rewrite; every strengthened scenario was perturbed and observed to fail. The verifier confirmed the runbook's 232-line loss and the solver-quests reclassification destroyed no live procedure, diffing the two sections the old banner promised to keep. Five residuals it raised were then closed: the unstaged lint fix, the ledger rows that overstated three moves, the missing autonomy default posture, the pre-commit bypass boundary, and the v1 lifecycle statechart. Recorded debt: R16 states two invariants because the sealed probe fixes the rule count at 25.
